verses.en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.pt: E prosseguindo Jó no seu discurso, disse:
verses.en_web: Job again took up his parable, and said,
verses.en_bbe: And Job again took up the word and said,

verses.en: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;
verses.pt: Ah! quem me dera ser como eu fui nos meses do passado, como nos dias em que Deus me guardava;
verses.en_web: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
verses.en_bbe: If only I might again be as I was in the months which are past, in the days when God was watching over me!

verses.en: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;
verses.pt: quando a sua lâmpada luzia sobre o minha cabeça, e eu com a sua luz caminhava através das trevas;
verses.en_web: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
verses.en_bbe: When his light was shining over my head, and when I went through the dark by his light.

verses.en: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
verses.pt: como era nos dias do meu vigor, quando o íntimo favor de Deus estava sobre a minha tenda;
verses.en_web: as I was in the ripeness of my days, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
verses.en_bbe: As I was in my flowering years, when my tent was covered by the hand of God;

verses.en: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
verses.pt: quando o Todo-Poderoso ainda estava comigo, e os meus filhos em redor de mim;
verses.en_web: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
verses.en_bbe: While the Ruler of all was still with me, and my children were round me;

verses.en: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
verses.pt: quando os meus passos eram banhados em leite, e a rocha me deitava ribeiros de azeite!
verses.en_web: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
verses.en_bbe: When my steps were washed with milk, and rivers of oil were flowing out of the rock for me.

verses.en: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
verses.pt: Quando eu saía para a porta da cidade, e na praça preparava a minha cadeira,
verses.en_web: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
verses.en_bbe: When I went out of my door to go up to the town, and took my seat in the public place,

verses.en: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
verses.pt: os moços me viam e se escondiam, e os idosos se levantavam e se punham em pé;
verses.en_web: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
verses.en_bbe: The young men saw me, and went away, and the old men got up from their seats;

verses.en: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
verses.pt: os príncipes continham as suas palavras, e punham a mão sobre a sua boca;
verses.en_web: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
verses.en_bbe: The rulers kept quiet, and put their hands on their mouths;

verses.en: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
verses.pt: a voz dos nobres emudecia, e a língua se lhes pegava ao paladar.
verses.en_web: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
verses.en_bbe: The chiefs kept back their words, and their tongues were joined to the roofs of their mouths.

verses.en: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:
verses.pt: Pois, ouvindo-me algum ouvido, me tinha por bem-aventurado; e vendo-me algum olho, dava testemunho de mim;
verses.en_web: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:
verses.en_bbe: For when it came to their ears, men said that I was truly happy; and when their eyes saw, they gave witness to me;

verses.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
verses.pt: porque eu livrava o miserável que clamava, e o órfão que não tinha quem o socorresse.
verses.en_web: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
verses.en_bbe: For I was a saviour to the poor when he was crying for help, to the child with no father, and to him who had no supporter.

verses.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
verses.pt: A bênção do que estava a perecer vinha sobre mim, e eu fazia rejubilar-se o coração da viúva.
verses.en_web: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
verses.en_bbe: The blessing of him who was near to destruction came on me, and I put a song of joy into the widow's heart.

verses.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
verses.pt: vestia-me da retidão, e ela se vestia de mim; como manto e diadema era a minha justiça.
verses.en_web: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
verses.en_bbe: I put on righteousness as my clothing, and was full of it; right decisions were to me a robe and a head-dress.

verses.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
verses.pt: Fazia-me olhos para o cego, e pés para o coxo;
verses.en_web: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
verses.en_bbe: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to him who had no power of walking.

verses.en: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
verses.pt: dos necessitados era pai, e a causa do que me era desconhecido examinava com diligência.
verses.en_web: I was a father to the needy. The cause of him who I didn’t know, I searched out.
verses.en_bbe: I was a father to the poor, searching out the cause of him who was strange to me.

verses.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
verses.pt: E quebrava os caninos do perverso, e arrancava-lhe a presa dentre os dentes.
verses.en_web: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
verses.en_bbe: By me the great teeth of the evil-doer were broken, and I made him give up what he had violently taken away.

verses.en: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
verses.pt: Então dizia eu: No meu ninho expirarei, e multiplicarei os meus dias como a areia;
verses.en_web: Then I said, ‘I shall die in my own house, I shall count my days as the sand.
verses.en_bbe: Then I said, I will come to my end with my children round me, my days will be as the sand in number;

verses.en: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
verses.pt: as minhas raízes se estendem até as águas, e o orvalho fica a noite toda sobre os meus ramos;
verses.en_web: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
verses.en_bbe: My root will be open to the waters, and the night mist will be on my branches,

verses.en: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
verses.pt: a minha honra se renova em mim, e o meu arco se revigora na minhã mão.
verses.en_web: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
verses.en_bbe: My glory will be ever new, and my bow will be readily bent in my hand.

verses.en: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
verses.pt: A mim me ouviam e esperavam, e em silêncio atendiam ao meu conselho.
verses.en_web: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
verses.en_bbe: Men gave ear to me, waiting and keeping quiet for my suggestions.

verses.en: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
verses.pt: Depois de eu falar, nada replicavam, e minha palavra destilava sobre eles;
verses.en_web: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
verses.en_bbe: After I had said what was in my mind, they were quiet and let my words go deep into their hearts;

verses.en: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
verses.pt: esperavam-me como à chuva; e abriam a sua boca como à chuva tardia.
verses.en_web: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
verses.en_bbe: They were waiting for me as for the rain, opening their mouths wide as for the spring rains.

verses.en: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
verses.pt: Eu lhes sorria quando não tinham confiança; e não desprezavam a luz do meu rosto;
verses.en_web: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
verses.en_bbe: I was laughing at them when they had no hope, and the light of my face was never clouded by their fear.

verses.en: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
verses.pt: eu lhes escolhia o caminho, assentava-me como chefe, e habitava como rei entre as suas tropas, como aquele que consola os aflitos.
verses.en_web: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
verses.en_bbe: I took my place as a chief, guiding them on their way, and I was as a king among his army. ...
